_comment: MAAP/DPS configuration for run_mur_maap.py. Paths here are s3:// hrefs,
not local directories -- bucket mounts do not exist inside a DPS job.
which prints both, discovered from workspace_bucket_credentials().

maap._granule_staging_note: direct = pass PO.DAAC's own s3:// hrefs to the job; the container fetches them itself, minting DAAC credentials from MAAP_PGT via common/bin/maap_credentials.py. This is the only behaviour now. 'workspace' is still accepted, for configs written when granules were copied into the workspace bucket first, and does the same thing.
maap._queues_note: maap.queue is the default for every module. maap.queues overrides it per process. Only MRVA needs a large worker (64 GiB / 16 cores); landice, iquam and l2p fit on 4-8 GiB. Run --list-queues to see what is available.
maap._algorithm_version_note: null = use the version this checkout builds (mur_maap/version.py), which is almost always what you want. Set it only to run packages deployed from a different revision -- a rollback, say. MAAP keeps every version ever registered, so naming an old one here succeeds silently and runs old code.
